title: AI-powered medical devices must be tested in real-world settings
title_zh: 基于人工智能的医疗设备必须在真实环境中进行测试
abstract: Tools that inform clinical decision-making require rigorous assessments equivalent to processes used to approve drugs and self-driving cars.
abstract_zh: 用于临床决策的工具需要与批准药物和自动驾驶汽车所采用的流程等效的严格评估。
